notes: Both ἕως πότε pairs kept as single units on 'how long', the gloss rule 64 cites for the pair; the split reading ('how' to πότε, 'long' to ἕως) is named in the unit notes.
ὑμῶν takes 'with you', the genitive's English preposition riding with the pronoun since no Greek preposition is expressed (rules 21, 36).
